name: slide-text-button
title: Slide Text Button
description: A button whose label slides up and is replaced by a second label on hover or keyboard focus. Renders as a button or a link.

props.name: text
props.description: Label shown at rest. Screen readers read this one.

props.name: hoverText
props.description: Label that slides in on hover or focus. Defaults to text.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a link instead of a button.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Defaults to a when href is set, else button.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
